component.name: AI Usage Monitor
component.summary: See AI usage, quota, resets, and spend truthfully in Plasma

description.p: AI Usage Monitor is a Plasma 6 widget for provider-reported usage and spend, synchronized coding-tool quota, local activity, balances, rate limits, and read-only connection checks. Daily Control prioritizes the source that needs attention, the lowest live quota, and the next live reset.

The widget stores secrets in KWallet and history on the local computer. Actual data, estimates, fixed fees, balances, connectivity, unavailable values, and currencies stay separate. Disabled-source history remains selectable and Analyst explains its coverage and sample requirements. The KDE Store frontend requires the matching compiled plugin from the Fedora COPR package or a source build.
